Title: General availability: Azure Machine Learning updates for native terminal

Body.Content:
Now, you can use Terminal in Azure Machine Learning to perform any CLI operation directly in the Azure Machine Learning studio, including: ​ 

  • Clone notebook files from Git Repository ​ 

  • Install a Python package ​ 

  • Execute Python Files   

Learn more.
